name: spawnpanel
notes: Cloud sales record: with its own cloud token (Routers > Cloud sales record), each device uploads its sales history, board coin lists, vendo names and rate cards, and the Sales page reads the cloud - the same totals on every phone, laptop and PC, even when the office PC is off. Needs cloud setup v3. Includes v5.16 (offline router never slows the panel) and v5.17 (Offline PPPoE).
